messages.content: You are taking part in a paid laboratory experiment. After a five-minute matrix task, productivity levels of EUR 5, 10 or 15 were assigned by performance thirds. In each of ten rounds you meet a different partner; roles and the pie can change. The pie is randomly selected from one partner’s productivity with equal probability. You are A and make the first offer. Every offer or demand states the money B receives; if agreed, A receives the pie minus that amount. B can accept or reject, and after a rejection B makes a demand. A can accept or reject that demand; bargaining alternates until agreement or the three-minute deadline. Amounts are multiples of EUR 0.10 between zero and the current pie. One round from 1–5 and one from 6–10 are randomly paid, in addition to the EUR 3 participation fee and later task incentives.

Current round: 6 of 10. Your gender: woman; B’s gender: man. The pie you see is EUR 10.00. This is the asymmetric information setting. If no agreement is reached, both receive zero. Individual productivities are not displayed. Only you see the actual pie; B knows it can be EUR 5, 10 or 15. This information rule is common knowledge. No previous-session modal agreement is provided. No proposal has yet been made in this negotiation. Recorded context is partial: earlier-round personal experiences and the exact remaining time at submission are not specified; this does not mean the participant had no such information. Choose your opening offer to B. Return only JSON with offer_to_B_cents, an integer multiple of 10.
